lines.text: Many learners say: My birthday is in May 5.
Better: My birthday is on May 5.
On! My birthday is on May 9.

native.tip: 한국어는 “5월 5일에”처럼 월과 일 모두 ‘에’를 써서 in으로 옮기기 쉬워요. 월만 말하면 in May, 날짜까지 말하면 on May 5예요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My birthday is on May 5.”

en.hook: For a date, say on, not in!
en.tip: Use in with a month and on with a day. Say “My birthday is on May 5.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “My birthday is in May 5.” Use in with a month and on with a day. Right: “My birthday is on May 5.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
